description: [Data utilities] Find which country and network an IP address belongs to, for fraud checks, geo-compliance or log enrichment. Use when a decision depends on where a request or login comes from. Price: $0.001 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/ip-geo

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address, or up to 50 comma-separated

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: ip_lookup
title: IP Country & Network Lookup (DB-IP Lite) ($0.001)
